decisions.reason: As a 2024 product line with several models that sits squarely in the firm's core automation offering, it is likely to be retained because it supports tailored precast plant solutions and signals a meaningful commercialization commitment.

The production analysis software fits the firm's strategy of integrated equipment-plus-digital-services and lifecycle support, so it is likely to stay, although software close to the core offer can be refined or folded into broader solutions if demand is modest.
